variety_description: Developed and released by CSSRI, Karnal in 2005 for irrigated alkaline areas. Semi-tall variety with the long slender grain is tolerant to alkalinity and moderately tolerant to zinc deficiency. Tolerant to leaf blast and leaf blight. High yield under normal soil conditions and around 4 ton per ha. in alkalinity prone areas. High HRR and grain weight. Non-lodging and non-shattering.
